BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.EXPEDITION.title: The Unexplored Tree
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.EXPEDITION.story.int: You've never seen a tree this tall. Warm light seeps through gaps in the bark, tracing the outline of a door. There might be a way out, but it pays to be careful.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.EXPEDITION.story.res: You decide to leave the tree alone. It's warm and safe here, so you rest before moving on.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.EXPEDITION.story.dep: A door-shaped gap opens in the trunk. You send a card ahead and agree to meet in the next area.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.EXPEDITION.story.wai: Your choice is confirmed. Waiting for the rest of the party.
BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.EXPEDITION.story.tea: The scouts have entered the tree. You'll meet again in the next area.
Send a card ahead. It returns in the next area.

BLACK_FLOW_SPIRE.UI.EXPEDITION.pass.desc: Keep your cards. If everyone stays, each player gains 2 Hope now.
